business_problem: Basikon needed to replace rigid, manual lending and leasing processes built on legacy architectures so banks and fintechs could launch digital products faster without human-error-prone back-office handoffs.
solution_summary: Basikon built its cloud-native lending and leasing SaaS platform on MongoDB Atlas so it could manage the full lifecycle of loans, leases, guarantees, and partner financing with a flexible document model instead of thousands of relational tables. The platform uses a 100% API architecture and low-code workflows to connect omnichannel origination, e-KYC, scoring APIs, approvals, e-signature, post-sale portals, insurance, and asset-maintenance steps in one system. MongoDB Atlas provides backups, replication, rapid environment creation, and a simpler schema model that lets the team ship new versions without heavy DDL work. Basikon also uses MongoDB aggregations and Atlas Search for reporting and query-heavy workflows, while MongoDB’s event-driven features reduce the need for extra messaging infrastructure and help teams deploy new features in weeks rather than years.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the lending and leasing lifecycle data and provides the managed operational database Basikon uses for its cloud-native SaaS platform.

solution_components.name: Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Supports query-heavy search and reporting workflows across financing records and operational data.

data_flow: Origination, e-KYC, scoring, approval, e-signature, and post-sale servicing data flow through Basikon APIs into MongoDB Atlas, where workflow logic, aggregations, and search support partner operations, reporting, and customer-facing lending journeys.
business_outcome: Basikon can deploy end-to-end lending and leasing systems in weeks, accelerate upgrades, avoid service interruptions, and give financial institutions a lower-cost way to launch digital financing products with less operational risk.
metrics: Basikon has managed to deploy over 15 of these systems in just three years.
Basikon says MongoDB Atlas is very stable and in 4 years it did not experience a single interruption of service or find a single bug.
“Upgrades are done in seconds with just the press of a button, increasing our agility 10x.”
architecture_clues: The platform is a 100% API SaaS system with low-code workflow capabilities.
MongoDB event-driven architecture features reduced the need for separate messaging infrastructure.
MongoDB aggregation pipelines are used for reporting and dashboarding.
Atlas backups and replication are part of the production-grade deployment model.
